text: Please add support for exporting to PDF; the product currently supports CSV only.
The app forgets saved changes after a restart. Please preserve what we saved.
Please raise the number of seats included in the basic subscription without an additional charge.
The feature works well. Please offer a lower monthly fee for teams with only two users.
The export works correctly, but it takes six screens to find it. Please simplify the navigation.
Please stop the export from dropping the final row. The button is easy to find but the file is incomplete.
We need a calendar integration. There is currently no way to connect a calendar.
All settings function, but their labels use unfamiliar terminology. Please explain them in plain language.
